scope: FXList and FXParticleSystemTemplate only; source fixtures pending full Windows XSD and SDK acceptance
schemaLimits: FXList and FXParticleSystemTemplate extend BaseAssetType, not BaseInheritableAsset; inheritFrom is invalid for both.
FXNuggetTypes exposes only fifteen known concrete elements; unknown numeric TypeId fallback remains component-only.
FXParticleEventModule exposes only Life and Collision; FXParticleEventBase remains component-only.
Raw SDK source must omit numeric TypeId; BAB creates polymorphic TypeId.
ObjectFilter list order is all IncludeThing children then all ExcludeThing children.
Particle root child order is Physics, Draw, Volume, Velocity, Event, Update after preceding optional root data.
dependencies: No TextureRef/RenderObjectRef/AudioEventInfoRef/EventFX imports. Shader and RenderGroup use AssetId strings; filter IncludeThing/ExcludeThing use weak GameObject names.
negativeMutations: Add inheritFrom to either root (not in BaseAssetType).
Add numeric TypeId to ViewShake (not an XML source attribute).
Remove one Lightning RandomSet (exactly two required).
Remove one RenderObject ObjectSet (exactly three required).
Remove EventTime from Life or HeightOffset from Collision.
